snippet.title: The Crane Rider's Tale - Official Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
From the creator of Butterfly Soup and Pom Gets Wi-Fi, The Crane Rider's Tale is a murder mystery inspired by Zero Escape, Disco Elysium, and Chinese folktales. Back it on Kickstarter now! https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/psychickiss/the-crane-riders-tale

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4654310/The_Crane_Riders_Tale/
